name: Substrate Inheritance SI-next candidate architecture

science_firewall.rule: Any physical target already frozen under v0.2 remains judged only under its preregistered v0.2 contract. SI-next outputs are additional diagnostics and cannot rescue, promote, demote, or reinterpret that target.

perspectives.relationship_layer_R: Reports agreement and disagreement among the three measurement views without collapsing them to a master score.
perspectives.uncertainty_layer_U: Propagates nonidentifiability and uncertainty from each required view without allowing precision in one view to erase uncertainty in another.

lineage.purpose: Track dominant carrier correspondence across multiple parent-child transitions.
lineage.tie_policy: Exact top-score ties are NONIDENTIFIABLE and are not broken arbitrarily.
lineage.threshold_policy: No physical correspondence threshold is introduced by this candidate.

multi_parent_attribution.purpose: Measure source-specific and interaction-specific response contributions when multiple candidate parents are present.
multi_parent_attribution.normalization_policy: Source effects are not forced to sum to one because interactions may be real and non-additive.

evidence_scope: software, mathematical, and synthetic architecture validation only until independently frozen real-system inputs are available
